note: Set A binds the drawing's labels to the correct components and details (cap plate 4 x 3/8, 3/4" hole in A3, 1 1/2" hole, 5x4x3/8 plate, 1/2" PL TYP, 1" PL, 3" STD pipe, 3x3x1/4 angle with (2) 3/4" bolts) and keeps typical/detail qualifiers. Set B invents several bindings: the 2" TYP and 3" TYP dimensions belong to the A1 PV post detail but are labeled as C3 crane-attachment, plate and component widths, and a bare 3/8" is called a fillet weld size with no supporting quote. Set B also uses vague entities ('Detail', 'component', 'crane attachment dimension') and a truncated quote, while omitting the cap plate and 5x4x3/8 plate facts that A captures. A's only real weaknesses are two speculative PV-post base-plate attribute bindings (width offset, edge distance).
